meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 当用户描述工具调用问题时，Claude 会进入调试模式：先让用户从四种症状中选一种，再按对应分支给出修复建议，如检查工具描述、参数 schema、循环控制，或引导五步设计新 schema。它不直接替用户代写完整代码，而是给范例文件让用户参照修改。
howto.when: 当工具调用出现“不调用工具”“参数错误”“循环不停”这类问题，或用户要设计新的函数 schema 时触发；框架专用、MCP server、生产可观测性问题不适用。

say.text: 我调用的 tool 没被触发，模型直接文字回答了，怎么排查？
say.note: Claude 会先让你从四个症状里选一个。

say.text: 我这个 schema 的参数类型是不是写错了？
ReAct 循环停不下来，可能哪里漏了？

howto.what_en: When the user describes tool-calling problems, Claude enters debugging mode: asks which of four symptom types, then fixes per branch (description, schema, loop, or 5-step design). It doesn't write full code; points to starter files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user faces tool-calling issues like 'model won't call the tool', wrong arguments, endless loops, or wants to design a new function schema. Not for framework-specific, MCP server, or production observability questions.

say_en.text: My tool never triggers; the model just replies in text. How do I debug?
say_en.note: Claude will first ask you to pick one of four symptom types.

say_en.text: Did I write the wrong parameter types in this schema?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to check type, required, and enum.

say_en.text: My ReAct loop won't stop. What could be missing?
say_en.note: Claude will help you check messages backfill and max_iter.
